subject: Campus accelerator credits — consolidation + deferred-billing option?
messages:
From: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@campuslab.org>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 18 Sep 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Campus accelerator credits & billing flexibility

Hi Chloe,

Thanks again for the product tour last week — CampusLab is excited about how Redwood can speed up our student-facing grading and feedback pipelines. Two quick asks from our program director (Elena) and finance: 1) Can we combine the 10k promo-credit you offered to each cohort into a single pool that the university can allocate across teams? 2) For accounting reasons we prefer deferred invoicing (bill at month-end for prior-month consumption) rather than up-front prepayments for promotional usage.

Attached is a rough forecast (we'll refine) and a one-page from Elena outlining cohort cadence. If either of these are non-starters let me know so we can adjust expectations before the next steering call.

Best,
Sanjay
Director, CampusLab Incubator
[Attachment: CampusLab_UsageForecast.xlsx (xlsx)]

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@campuslab.org>, Elena Torres <elena@eduincubator.co>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2027 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Campus accelerator credits & billing flexibility

Hi Sanjay / Elena — really glad CampusLab liked the demo. Short answers up front: we can discuss pooling the cohort credits into a single allocation, and we can explore a deferred-billing cadence for promotional credits for education partners — both are possible but need a small contractual addendum plus internal approvals (finance/legal).

Proposed next steps:
- I can draft a two-paragraph addendum that clarifies: pooled-credit bucket, allocation rules, and a 30-day deferred invoice for promo usage.
- Need internal sign-off from Sales Ops and Accounting for any change to standard prepay flows.
- If helpful, we can limit the pooled credits to an initial pilot quarter (Q4) and revisit based on actual consumption.

Would you be open to a brief call Thursday to walk through Elena's cohort calendar and the forecast? If not, I'll send a draft addendum and a short rubric for how credits are allocated.

Thanks — chloe
Chloe Martin | Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Sep 2027 11:05:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Campus accelerator credits & billing flexibility — approval/ops needed

Team — forwarding a partner request from CampusLab (external contacts copied on the original). Key asks: pooled cohort promo credits (10k per cohort consolidated) + deferred monthly invoicing for promo usage.

Why this matters: CampusLab is a strategic education partner (30+ teams running hackterm projects per quarter). If we can make credits allocable across cohorts and allow month-end invoicing for promo credit consumption, we reduce friction for conversion to Dedicated next year.

Questions for approvals/ops:
- Ben: commercial ok to consolidate the 10k credits into a single pool for an initial pilot (Q4) with a clause that unused credits expire at quarter-end?
- Laura: can we provide a one-quarter deferred-billing exception for promo credits (finance would invoice month-end for prior-month promo usage rather than require upfront prepayment)? If not, what's the minimum guardrail finance needs (e.g., PO on file, $20k security hold)?
- Irene: quick legal ask — I'd like a two-paragraph addendum that: (a) states pooled-credit mechanics and allocation owner; (b) clarifies invoicing cadence for promo credits and that promo credits are non-refundable and expire at quarter close. Can legal produce a short redline?

I've attached the CampusLab forecast they sent and a draft stub I've been working on (proposed-credit-addendum-draft.pdf). If we can land this by Friday we'll make the Thursday call and move to signature next week.

Thanks — chloe
[Attachment: proposed-credit-addendum-draft.pdf (pdf)]

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Chloe Martin <chloe.martin@redwood.com>, Sanjay Rao <sanjay.rao@campuslab.org>, Elena Torres <elena@eduincubator.co>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Campus accelerator credits & billing flexibility — pilot approval

Hi all — quick update after huddle with Finance & Legal. Short answer: we can run the requested pilot with the following conditions.

Agreed pilot terms (Q4 trial):
- Consolidated credit pool: Redwood will allocate 40,000 promotional tokens to CampusLab for Q4. CampusLab may internally assign tokens to cohorts/teams; Redwood will honor allocations administered by the named campus admin. Unused tokens expire at 2027-12-31.
- Invoicing cadence: Redwood Finance will invoice CampusLab monthly in arrears for actual promotional usage. Promo credits are consumed first and will be reflected as line items; any usage above promo tokens will be billed at standard EDU list rates.
- Safeguards: CampusLab must provide a PO for Q4 (covers expected usage) and a $10k refundable security hold to be released after Q4 reconcilliation OR agree to net 30 payment terms for any overage > $5k.
- Legal addendum: Irene will circulate a short two-paragraph addendum this afternoon capturing pooled mechanics + invoicing cadence. Please review.

Chloe/Sanjay — please confirm you accept these pilot constraints and I'll raise the deal in our system and route to Finance for the PO and security-hold instructions. If CampusLab wants a higher initial pool we can discuss scaling, but the safeguards above are required for any deferred-billing pilot.

Ben
Ben Carter | Sr. Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
